get.summary: Start an OAuth or OIDC login
get.description: Redirects to the provider and sets the `llmobs_oauth` cookie. `redirect` is kept when it starts with `/`, does not start with `//` or `/\`, is at most 1024 bytes, and contains no ASCII control character. Otherwise the browser returns to `/`. An unknown provider is 404. When metadata cannot be loaded, the response redirects to `/login?error=provider_unavailable` and sets no cookie.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Relative path to open after a successful login.

parameters.name: setup_token
parameters.description: First-run setup token. Stored in the login cookie and accepted only while no user exists.

302.description: Redirect to the provider, or to `/login?error=provider_unavailable`.

get.summary: Finish an OAuth or OIDC login
get.description: Clears the login cookie. Success sets the session cookie and redirects to the saved relative path. Failure redirects to `/login?error=<code>`. Codes: `invalid_state`, `provider_error`, `provider_unavailable`, `email_not_verified`, `domain_not_allowed`, `signup_closed`, `account_disabled`, `link_refused`, `setup_required`, `seat_limit`, `sso_unavailable`, `sso_required`. The provider is `github`, `google`, `oidc:<name>`, or `sso` (an org's provider, started through `/api/auth/sso/authorize`).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State value from the authorization redirect.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error code from the provider, when it refused the login.

get.summary: Start an org's single sign-on login
get.description: Starts a login through the identity provider of the org that owns the email domain (D-P-60). A domain that is not verified, a disabled provider (except for an owner's Test sign-in, D-P-57) and an unknown domain all redirect to `/login?error=sso_unavailable` with no cookie. Discovery and authorize share 300 requests a minute per client IP; a burst over that is 429. `redirect` is kept as for the instance providers.

parameters.description: Relative path to open after a successful login.

patch.description: Sets `enabled` and `enforced`, each optional (D-P-57, D-P-58, D-P-61). TracePage.description: One page of results. `next_cursor` is null when there is no next page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

TraceSummary.description:

Spec 01 § Trace and spec 09 § Observability data.

cache_read_tokens.description: Sum of cache-read tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

cache_write_tokens.description: Sum of cache-write tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

cost_total.description: Sum of span costs, USD. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

end_time.description: Latest span end, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

has_root.description: Whether a span with no parent is present.

input_preview.description: Root input preview, or the first `llm` span's.

input_tokens.description: Sum of span input tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

metadata.description: Root metadata, filled with keys from later spans when absent.

name.description: Root span name, or the earliest span's name when there is no root.

output_preview.description: Root output preview, or the first `llm` span's.

output_tokens.description: Sum of span output tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

reasoning_tokens.description: Sum of reasoning tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

root_span_id.description: Span id of the root. Omitted when the trace has no root.

scores.description: Latest score of each name attached to this trace.

start_time.description: Earliest span start, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch. JSON is RFC 3339.

status.description: `error` when any span errored, otherwise the root's status, otherwise `unset`.

tags.description: Sorted distinct tags of every span.

total_tokens.description: Sum of total tokens. Omitted when every span omitted the field.

TreeSpan.description:
One span in a flat pre-order trace tree.

Spec 09 § Response shapes.

depth.description: Distance from the root. Roots are 0.

detached.description: The parent is missing, or this span sits in a parent cycle.

UnknownPart.description: A part type this version does not model; render as JSON. Its `type` is never one of the modelled types, so exactly one `Part` branch matches a valid part. Parts that are not objects, or modelled types missing a required field, are kept verbatim by the server but are outside this schema.

type.description: Part type, when the payload has one.

UpdateAdminUserRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id}`.

Absent fields stay as they are.

UpdateAlertRuleRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /alert-rules/{id}`. An absent field keeps its value. A new
`condition`, or a change of `enabled`, resets the state to `ok` (D-K-4).

channel_ids.description: New channels of this project, at most 10. `[]` removes every channel.

condition.description: New condition. Defaults are filled in.

name.description: New display name, 1–100 characters after trimming.

UpdateChannelRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /channels/{id}`. An absent field keeps its value; `headers` replaces the whole map.

UpdateEvaluatorRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}/evaluators/{id}` body. Absent means unchanged.

Its `Debug` prints flags, not the config or the secret.

config.description:
The kind-specific configuration. For a webhook, replaces the URL, the headers and the
timeout together, so it must come with `webhook_secret` (400 otherwise).

webhook_secret.description:
Replaces the signing secret of a webhook, 16 to 256 characters. Required with a webhook
`config`, so a saved secret never signs requests to a new URL. An empty string is refused.

UpdateLlmConnectionRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/orgs/{org}/llm-connections/{id}` body. Absent means
unchanged; an empty body is valid and changes only `updated_at`.

adapter.description: The provider API the connection talks to.

base_url.description: Provider endpoint. An empty string clears it.

default_model.description: Model used when a caller names none. An empty string clears it.

extra_headers.description: Replaces the whole header map. An empty object clears it.

max_concurrency.description: Provider calls the connection runs at once, 1 to 64.

name.description: Display name, 1 to 100 characters after trimming.

structured_output.description: How the provider is asked to fill the answer schema.

UpdateMeRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/me`.

A missing `name` and JSON null both clear the display name.

name.description: Display name. Null or omitted clears it. A present value is trimmed to 1–100 characters.

UpdateOnlineRuleRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}/online-rules/{id}` body. Absent means unchanged.

There is no `evaluator_id` or `target`: sending either is a 400 (unknown field). Optional
fields refuse `null`; removing the budget is `clear_budget: true`.

budget_period.description: Period of the budget. Needed with `budget_usd` when the rule has none yet.

budget_usd.description: Budget per period, in USD. Judge evaluators only.

clear_budget.description: Removes the budget. Cannot come with `budget_usd` or `budget_period`.

enabled.description: Turns the rule on or off.

filter.description: Filter over the target's view. `""` clears it.

name.description: Display name, 1 to 128 characters after trimming.

sample_rate.description: Share of the matching targets to evaluate, in `(0, 1]`.

variable_mapping.description: Replaces the whole mapping, 1 to 32 variables.

UpdateProjectRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}`.

`retention_days: null` keeps data forever. Omitting the field leaves retention unchanged.

name.description: Display name. Absent leaves the name unchanged. A present value is trimmed to 1–100 characters.

retention_days.description: Days to keep data, from 1 to 36500. Null keeps data forever. Absent leaves retention unchanged.

trace_completion_timeout_s.description:
Seconds without a new span after which a trace counts as complete for online rules, 10 to 3600.
Absent leaves it unchanged.

UpdateSavedView.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}/saved-views/{id}`.

Omitted fields are left unchanged. Spec 09 § Observability data.

is_default.description: The default of its scope: among the owner's private views of this kind ("my default"), or among the project's shared views of this kind ("project default"). Setting it clears the other default of that scope (D-H-6). Omitted: unchanged.

shared.description: Visible to every member of the project. Omitted: unchanged.

state.description: Opaque UI state: list-page URL params, or `{query, params, range}` / `{query, params, from, to}` for SQL (D-H-7).

UpdateScoreDefinitionRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{project}/score-definitions/{id}` body. Absent means unchanged.

`min_value` and `max_value` cannot be cleared once set. Archive the definition instead.

archived.description: `true` archives the definition; `false` restores it, unless another live one has its name.

categories.description: Labels of a categorical score: 1 to 100, unique.

description.description: What the score means. An empty string clears it.

max_value.description: Highest allowed value. Only for numeric scores, above `min_value`.

min_value.description: Lowest allowed value. Only for numeric scores.

name.description: Score name, 1 to 255 bytes after trimming.

UriPart.description: Media addressed by a URI, including `media://` after extraction.

mime_type.description: MIME type, when known. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

modality.description: Media kind, when known. Omitted when absent. An explicit `null` from the source is kept (D65).

UsageDay.description: One UTC day of an org's usage, summed over its projects.
